brand_tagline: Açaí puro da Amazônia, cremoso e preparado na hora
app_type: digital menu / food ordering landing page
target_audience: Lovers of authentic Brazilian açaí, health-conscious foodies, dessert seekers looking for quick online ordering via WhatsApp

business_pivot_context.previous_identity: Forno & Fuoco (Italian rustic pizzeria, wood-fire, cream/green/burnt-red, Playfair Display)
business_pivot_context.new_identity: Açaiteria (100% açaí shop, authentic Brazilian Amazonian vibrancy, deep purple, creamy cashew/condensed milk whites, guarana warm amber & fresh lime accents, modern artisanal typography)
business_pivot_context.menu_focus: Exclusively açaí products (500ml Individual and 1L Família) with customizable paid toppings and extras

design_decisions.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 + ARCHETYPE 5 FUSION: Tropical Amazonian Craft meets Modern Berry Luxury (rich velvet açaí purple depths, crisp fresh contrasts, inviting tactile warmth)
design_decisions.theme: Light theme default with deep jewel-toned berry accents and high-contrast surfaces

typography.headline_font: Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit (Display Sans with bold organic personality, wide stance, tight tracking), paired with Cormorant Garamond / Syne for editorial flair

scale_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[0.95]
scale_hierarchy.subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl font-normal leading-relaxed text-purple-900/75
scale_hierarchy.caption_overline: text-xs font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-purple-600

contrast_rules.primary_buttons: Background: #581c87 (Deep Purple) or #7e22ce (Vibrant Purple), Text: #ffffff (White) — contrast ratio > 7:1
contrast_rules.accent_badges: Background: #fef3c7 (Warm Cream/Gold), Text: #78350f (Dark Amber) or Background: #f3e8ff, Text: #581c87
contrast_rules.headings_on_light: Color: #2b0a3d (Rich Deep Açaí) on #fbf7ff (Off-white lilac) — APCA contrast passes effortlessly

visual_enhancers.surface_treatment: Crisp white cards with 1px border (#eedef8), subtle ambient berry drop-shadow (rgba(88, 28, 135, 0.06)), rounded-2xl corners (16px to 24px)
visual_enhancers.badge_treatment: Pill badges with subtle purple tint and crisp uppercase monospace tracking
visual_enhancers.texture: Clean organic feel with subtle natural lighting and vibrant fruit photography
visual_enhancers.marquee_ribbon: Editorial Ribbon with low contrast lilac-purple background (#f3e8ff) and deep purple text (#4a154b), scrolling smoothly with values: '100% PURO DO PARÁ · POLPA ARTESANAL · ZERO XAROPE ARTIFICIAL · CREMOSIDADE MÁXIMA · ENTREGAS RÁPIDAS VIA WHATSAPP'

ordering_flow_guidelines.step_1_product_selection: User views product cards (500ml or 1L). Clicking 'Personalizar & Pedir' opens the Topping Customizer Modal.
ordering_flow_guidelines.step_2_topping_customizer: Interactive chip grid where each topping shows its name, price (+ R$ X,XX) and an active checkbox checkmark. Real-time dynamic total calculation shows base price + sum of selected toppings. CTA button: 'Adicionar à Sacola'.
ordering_flow_guidelines.step_3_cart_drawer: Slide-in drawer from right (Framer Motion). Lists base size + comma-separated selected toppings, item quantity counters (+ / -), subtotal, fixed delivery fee (R$ 5,00), and bold total. Includes empty state with friendly açaí bowl graphic.
ordering_flow_guidelines.step_4_delivery_form: Modal collecting customer's Nome, WhatsApp, Endereço de entrega, Forma de Pagamento (Pix, Cartão na entrega, Dinheiro), and Observações.
ordering_flow_guidelines.step_5_whatsapp_checkout: Generates a pre-formatted Brazilian WhatsApp message and redirects to https://wa.me/559191711504?text=... followed by a celebration confirmation modal.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Completely remove all pizza remnants: replace pizza image imports, pizza naming, pizza descriptions ('pomodoro', 'fior di latte', 'forno a lenha', '450°') with authentic açaí shop terminology ('Açaiteria', 'Açaí Puro', 'Acompanhamentos', 'Cremoso', 'Origem Pará').
2. Update index.css fonts to load Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono. Set body background to #fbf7ff and text to #2b0a3d.

3. Replace color tokens in App.css / index.css: switch from warm Italian beige (#f8f2e8) and tomato red (#e54b35) to rich açaí berry purple (#2b0a3d / #581c87 / #7e22ce) with amber/gold (#f59e0b) and fresh cream accents.

4. Update the products list in App.js: ONLY açaí items (Açaí 500ml for R$ 28,00 and Açaí Família 1 Litro for R$ 48,00). Keep the paid complement customizer with Granola (R$ 4,00), Leite Ninho (R$ 5,00), Banana (R$ 3,00), Morango (R$ 5,00), Paçoca (R$ 4,00), and Leite Condensado (R$ 4,00).

5. Maintain all critical flows: Customizer modal with instant sum, cart drawer with item count and remove/qty buttons, checkout delivery modal with client inputs, and WhatsApp redirect to +55 91 9171-1504.
6. Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in testing_attributes are present on interactive and key elements for test verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look. Use vibrant tropical berry purple tones, authentic textures, crisp white cards, and clear typography.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, modals, or dropdowns. Always use solid or frosted crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-purple-950/90 or bg-white/95).
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions for interactive states (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease).
Ensure high contrast on all text: white text on purple/emerald buttons, deep purple (#2b0a3d) on light lilac backgrounds.
All buttons, chips, inputs, links, and drawers must include their designated data-testid attributes.
